summary: This is not a proposal but a progress note: it reports the audit surface it has measured (~15.6k LOC of meta-o, 2.2k LOC Python QC template, 7 skills, 6 authoritative spec docs, 80 ledger decisions) and states that four research agents are still running and their findings will be folded in later. I confirmed the corresponding file approach-opus1mhigh-R0-proposal.md is zero bytes. There is no architecture, no lifecycle, no skill list, no backend flows, no goal design, no tooling audit, no migration plan and no decision ledger — so none of the task's 26 required output sections or 36 mandatory questions can be assessed, and there is nothing to stress-test. Its only substantive contribution is an accurate framing of how large the audit surface is, which is consistent with what I verified in the repository (src/{adapters,cli,core,watchdog} as .mts, nine quality/*.mjs scripts, seven skills, install.sh and update.sh present). It cannot be scored on merit or adopted; it needs resubmission after its research completes, or the round needs extending.
